name: comp-286
title: Info Alert With Link
blurb: Blue info banner with icon, message, action link, and close button.
description: Static info alert banner with InfoIcon in blue, message text, optional action link, and dismissible close button. No interaction hooks.
use_when: You need to display persistent, dismissible info messages with secondary actions that remain visible until closed.
avoid_when: For system-wide stacked notifications; use a toast system that queues messages instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
